cost.note: Shared successful gates and failed reuse gates counted once across BF/EPFL. Original trajectories, models, prior import failures and CPU cost separately retained. Receipt time is not scheduler allocation.

limitations: Repeated CAL development data; three seeds; correlated starts and perturbations. No TEST or confirmatory claim.
Same four arms per job and same starts per source. Between encoders, original coarse starts may differ.
The actual ascent vector is applied_ascent_gradient. Full-term gradients are a separate autograd call and can differ slightly; first-pass norms/scale audited, repeated-backward drift disclosed.
Gradient composition at each changing current pose includes Adam history and nonlinear interactions; not an additive decomposition of training or generalization.
Primary path means and common-P1 candidate selection are distinct; do not choose starts by truth.
No fullJ arm here: positive-only/crossed paths are mechanism controls, not fullVCS-QMI.
Historical native trajectories are not reused as comparators after failed reproduction gate; drift retained descriptively.
conclusions_cn: BF四臂统一P1选出的严格/宽松成功率均100%，该小CAL集无法辨别失败尾部。
VCS表示norm主效应+0.054916px三seed均正且LOSO稳，方向主效应−0.099185但LOSO可翻正；交互−0.116233三seed负且LOSO稳。不能用单个全局梯度缩放解释正对二次项作用。
BCE方向主效应+0.071239（2/3正、LOSO稳），norm均值−0.041448由一个seed主导，2/3seed反向，未通过信号；NCE norm+0.083801和交互+0.145710通过描述信号。作用随表示变化。
原生重复轨迹终点绝对漂移平均0.121–0.231px、最大3.914px；与部分小对照差同量级。此处包含不同运行/梯度求取路径，不是隔离后的纯CUDA噪声估计。旧端点不作为新四臂科学对照。
等待EPFL九项并列，不把BF单个信号推广为优化器/训练配方。需在提出基于细小位姿差的新实施前量化同代码、同作业内重复与执行顺序敏感性。
decision: CompleteEPFLunchanged. Do not modify ongoing KD/shuffle. Consider bounded same-code paired repeat/order diagnostic if interpretation relies on effects comparable to observed drift; no occupancy duplicates or parameter grid.
